title: IBM Flying Cars Commercial
summary: A 2000 IBM commercial in which Avery Brooks complains that we still have no flying cars. It plays on the failed futurist promises of the twentieth century.
why: HN commenters reference it, sometimes jokingly, in flying-car threads as an ironic sign that culture had written off the idea.

quote.text: Deliciously ironic considering it represented the fact that mainstream culture had all but written off the idea entirely.
